title: [P1][interaction,design-system] Enabled Button and Checkbox miss cursor-pointer
goal: components/ui/button.tsx and components/ui/checkbox.tsx only set cursor-not-allowed when disabled; Tailwind v4 preflight leaves the enabled state at cursor: default. This is inconsistent with radio.tsx and list-row.tsx in the same design system, which already set cursor-pointer on their clickable state. Affects every submit button and every preset/tick-off checkbox app-wide.
in_scope: Add cursor-pointer to Button's enabled/clickable state in components/ui/button.tsx.
Add cursor-pointer to Checkbox's enabled/clickable state in components/ui/checkbox.tsx.
Spot-check that disabled states still correctly show cursor-not-allowed (regression check, not a new requirement).
out_of_scope: Auditing every other interactive component for the same gap -- this story covers Button and Checkbox specifically, the two flagged by the audit; a broader sweep is a separate story if more are found.
Any other visual change to Button or Checkbox beyond the cursor property.
acceptance: Enabled Button and Checkbox instances show cursor-pointer on hover, matching Radio and ListRow's existing behavior. Disabled instances still show cursor-not-allowed, unchanged.
invariants: This is a single CSS-class-level change -- it must not alter any component's layout, sizing, or click behavior.
